title: Render pipeline cache key ignores the vertex buffer layout: a stride-16 pipeline is reused for a stride-12 geometry
expect_note: no existing diagnostic code covers a pipeline vertex-binding stride that does not match the bound vertex data
expected_finding: after the geometry swap, render_pipeline<storage_geometry> (vertex binding 0 stride 16) draws 6 vertices from BufferAttribute.position, a 72-byte buffer packed at 12 bytes per vertex: the draw needs 96 bytes and reads every vertex after the first at the wrong offset
